description:
Role: GTM

This position requires being based in Monterrey - Remote

ABOUT Wonderful

Wonderful enables enterprises to build, test, deploy, and monitor AI agents for their most complex needs, serving customers and employees seamlessly across voice, chat, email, and back-office systems in any language or cultural context.

 

Role Overview:

  • You’ll lead and close high-stakes enterprise deals across the region, expand existing relationships, and create durable revenue streams with major organizations.

  • Build and grow trusted relationships with CxOs, IT leaders, and Customer Service executives in large enterprises.

  • Drive measurable growth within the accounts you own, turning them into long-term success stories.

  • Expand Wonderful’s footprint by opening new doors and landing fresh enterprise customers.

  • Hit - and exceed - activity, pipeline, and revenue targets, setting the bar for sales excellence.

  • Keep customer details sharp and actionable in Salesforce: use cases, purchase timelines, next steps, and forecasts.

  • Sell on value, not features using a solution-based approach that proves real business impact for customers.

 

Requirements:

  • 12+ years of smashing Sales quotas in SaaS or AI-driven solutions, consistently closing large, complex accounts with multi-stakeholder cycles

  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and negotiation skills

  • The ability to work independently, manage a sales pipeline, and prioritize effectively

  • Excellent English (written and spoken) plus fluency in local language

  • A passion for artificial intelligence and a "get-it-done" attitude

  • A "hunter" mentality with a track record of generating new leads and closing deals

  • A proven ability to navigate and win in early-stage, high-growth environments, staying sharp and effective with limited oversight

  • Strong relationships with CxOs and senior decision-makers at enterprise level with the credibility to open new doors fast

  • The skill to cut through tech jargon and turn technical capabilities into clear, compelling business value that makes executives lean in

  • Proven wins working hand-in-hand with System Integrators and Hyperscalers to drive joint success

  • Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent hustle and expertise)
